items.title: Google Antigravity rolls out browser use for agents
facts: Browser use has been rolling out in Antigravity, closing the loop between researching, writing code, and verifying it live.
You choose what to log into, downloads pause until you approve them, and the agent can use the browser to run multiple tasks at once.

items.title: Gemini 4 Carbon and /swarm multi-agent preview land in Antigravity
facts: Today, we’re rolling out Gemini 4 Carbon inside Google Antigravity alongside /swarm (in preview), pairing our strongest model for long-horizon software engineering with native multi-agent team orchestration.
Google AI Ultra subscribers can build with Gemini 4 Carbon in the Antigravity App, the Antigravity CLI, and Antigravity IDE extensions, and /swarm is rolling out today in preview.

items.title: Command Code Desktop v0.1.61 lets Claude Code run as an agent in chat
facts: Use Claude Code as an agent right in the chat.
DeepSeek V4.1 Flash is now the default model. Add Gemini 4 Carbon, Claude Fable 5.2, Muse Ember, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Ultrafast and Ling 3.1 Flash 1019 to the model picker.

items.title: Developer reports opening 23 PRs in one day with AI agents and adjusting workflow
facts: I opened 23 PRs today on 3 different contexts, and to be honest I had to put most of my mental effort on not getting lost.
These are the changes I made to handle 2-3x the volume: Better design since the beginning, Critical PRs go to me for review, New task = new session, No coordinators past 150k tokens.

items.title: Roma 2.0 launches as to-do list for coordinating multiple AI agents
facts: Roma automatically creates tasks and hands them to the right agent. Allowing you and your agents to work together, with shared context.

items.title: Claude Fable 5.2 tops Signal65 PINNACLE coding benchmark
facts: Claude Fable 5.2 passed 28 of 30 Frontier Class coding jobs on Signal65 PINNACLE. No other model has passed more than 21.
It also costs $30.51 per passed job in our testing, 3.9x Claude Opus 5.5.

items.title: Qwen4-Max-Preview builds full interactive 3D Earth app in under 2 hours via agent
facts: Qwen4-Max-Preview built a full 3D Earth mission control app in 1 hour and 47 minutes using Hermes harness.
From prompt to live website: started 9:23 AM, deployed and verified 11:10 AM.

items.title: Discussions on agent coordination and the need for isolation in multi-agent coding
facts: A coding agent picking up a task and writing to your repo needs the handoff to come with isolation, not just shared context. That's what git worktrees are for.
